# WJ20 · Phiên chat AI · Xóa bản tóm tắt

Group **WJ · Quản trị agent (Next.js)** · dialog · Next.js: **exists (design W2)** (`/admin/threads`) · account `owner`

## Purpose
Dialog or drawer of [WJ15](WJ15.md) · Phiên chat AI: Xóa bản tóm tắt. Page: Chat sessions of the assistant: one per conversation (private or group), with their context, summary, per-step traces and a per-session bot switch.

## Agent and care context
- The per-session bot switch is the zalo-agent `bot_enabled` flag. In the care design it is extended into the control-state machine AUTO → HANDOFF_ROUTING → STAFF (PLAN-AI01-M section 5); the per-patient timeline (WK28) shows that state, this page only the raw switch.
- Sessions may hold patient data: only staff who are authorised see them.

## Who may see it
- Account in this frame: `owner` (a mock account of `mock/auth.ts`; the back end decides the real matrix, the menu is a convenience).
- Gate: `admin.agents` (the account filter also needs `admin.accounts`).
- Roles that can open the page: owner, manager.
- Menu entry: "Phiên chat" in the section "Quản trị agent", shown when the role holds any of `admin.agents`.

## Key actions
- (actions of the page; this state or dialog adds the controls its Layout lists)
- Search by name or thread id; account filter; pager
- Bot switch per session ("Bot đang bật - bấm để tắt")
- "Xem": detail drawer with the tabs "Hội thoại" and "Trace agent"
- Delete the conversation, delete the summary, clear the whole context (three confirm dialogs)

## Business rules
- Patient safety is a policy profile, never a removed feature: `patient_channel` (the default: messages to patients go to the review queue and a person sends them; memory from patient content is off; image, video, document and web tools are off; a red flag goes to a doctor before any model call; personal data is masked before the model; identity of a Zalo user is confirmed before the assistant names a patient) and `staff_assistant` (internal, staff-only accounts). The profile is set per Zalo account and per agent, the stricter of the two applies (PLAN-AI01 section 5).
